howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你使用 Firebase Realtime Database 同步实时数据、读写 JSON 树、设置监听器、启用离线持久化、管理在线状态、编写安全规则。
howto.when: 当你询问如何同步实时数据、设计数据结构、读写数据、设置离线持久化、管理在线状态、分片或编写安全规则时触发。

say.text: 如何在 Flutter 里用 Firebase 实时数据库同步聊天消息？
say.note: Claude 会指导你设置数据库、写入数据和监听更新。

say.text: 帮我写一段离线持久化的配置代码。
say.note: Claude 会给出启用持久化并设置缓存大小的代码。

say.text: 怎么用 onDisconnect 做在线状态？
say.note: Claude 会讲解监听连接状态并设置断开时的清理操作。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to guide you in using Firebase Realtime Database for syncing real-time data, reading/writing JSON trees, creating listeners, enabling offline persistence, managing presence, sharding, and writing security rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about syncing real-time data, structuring data, reading/writing, setting offline persistence, managing presence, sharding, or writing security rules.

say_en.text: How to sync chat messages with Firebase Realtime Database in Flutter?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you on setting up, writing data, and listening.

say_en.text: Write code for offline persistence configuration.
say_en.note: Claude will give code to enable persistence and set cache size.

say_en.text: How to implement presence with onDisconnect?
say_en.note: Claude will explain listening to connection state and setting cleanup.
